title: The Rough Trail
author: Bram Delacroix
blurb: Sable Brightwater, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
